modes.title: Action
modes.body: The interaction you desire to perform on the object e.g. "shift"

modes.title: Direction
modes.body: An optional modifier that resolves spatial ambiguity in spatial commands. e.g. "right"

modes.title: Selection Mode
modes.body: Entered upon speech selection while editing an entry. Sonically this is represented by a looping audio section.

modes.title: Playback Mode
modes.body: Entered upon playback of captured speech. In this mode, captured speech is presented back in its natural spoken form.

modes.title: Echo Mode
modes.body: Entered upon echoing of captured speech. In this mode, captured speech is presented back as computer-synthesized speech.

modes.title: Dialog Mode
modes.body: Entered upon the activation of the dialog, such as when deleting an entry. Prompts for a response chosen from a restricted set of voice commands.

modes.title: Walk Mode
modes.body: Entered upon the completion of the walk voice command. Selects a single word and loops its natural spoken form followed by the computer-synthesized form, allowing for cross-comparison. Shifting between words is user-controlled.

modes.title: Run Mode
modes.body: Entered upon the completion of the run voice command. Advances automatically through a passage playing its natural spoken form followed by the computer-synthesized form, allowing for cross-comparison.

modes.title: Orderless
modes.body: Tokens can be uttered in any order. e.g. "PLAY ENTRY" vs "ENTRY PLAY"

modes.title: Supports padded statements
modes.body: Padded voice commands are permitted, allowing you to include “filler” words between tokens. e.g. "Please <START> an <ENTRY>"

modes.title: Object Omission
modes.body: When in an “object mode”, such as when we have selected speech, omitting the object is permitted. e.g. "SHIFT WALK RIGHT" -> "SHIFT RIGHT"

modes.title: Action Omission
modes.body: If an object has only one action with a direction, including a direction and omitting the action token is permitted. e.g. "SHIFT WALK RIGHT" -> "WALK RIGHT"

modes.title: Action Omission
modes.body: If an object has a single action, omitting the action token is permitted. One must still include any required direction. e.g. "EXPORT AUDIO" -> "AUDIO"

modes.title: Combining Special Cases
modes.body: Object Omission and Action Omission can be used simultaneously. e.g. "SHIFT WALK RIGHT" -> "RIGHT"

modes.title: Undo/Redo
modes.body: The <CHANGE> token can be omitted when calling undo or redo.

descriptions.PLAY_ENTRY: Initiate playback of a selected entry.
descriptions.PAUSE_ENTRY: Pause listening for new entry speech.
descriptions.START_ENTRY: Initiate listening for new entry speech.
descriptions.STOP_ENTRY: Terminate listening for new entry speech.
descriptions.RESUME_ENTRY: Return to listening for new entry speech after pause.
descriptions.ECHO_ENTRY: Initiate echo of a selected entry.
descriptions.EDIT_ENTRY: Initiate listening for entry speech in an existing entry.
descriptions.EXPORT_ENTRY: Initiate audio or text export for selected entry.
descriptions.ENTER_ENTRY: (From the entry list) Navigate into a selected entry.
descriptions.ENTER_ENTRY_LIST: (From an entry) Navigate out of a selected entry back to the entry list.
descriptions.PLAY_ECHO: Initiate echo of a selected entry.
descriptions.INCREASE_VOLUME: Raises the loudness of device sound.
descriptions.DECREASE_VOLUME: Lowers the loudness of device sound.
descriptions.INCREASE_ECHO_RATE: Accelerates the rate at which echo and system speech is delivered.
descriptions.DECREASE_ECHO_RATE: Decelerates the rate at which echo and system speech is delivered.
descriptions.INCREASE_PLAYBACK_RATE: Accelerates the rate at which playback is delivered.
descriptions.DECREASE_PLAYBACK_RATE: Decelerates the rate at which playback is delivered.
descriptions.UPDATE_SELECTION: Initiates update sequence to replace arbitrarily selected speech.
descriptions.COPY_SELECTION: Copies arbitrarily selected speech to clipboard.
descriptions.CUT_SELECTION: Copies arbitrarily selected speech to clipboard and removes it from entry.
descriptions.EXPORT_SELECTION: Initiate audio or text export for arbitrary selection.
descriptions.EXPAND_SELECTION: Extends selection by integrating neighboring words.
descriptions.REDUCE_SELECTION: Shrinks selection by releasing boundary words.
descriptions.PAUSE_RUN: Change the current run into a walk, repeating the same word or entry.
descriptions.SELECT_WORD: Enter selection mode by selecting word nearest to speech cursor.
descriptions.SELECT_SENTENCE: Enter selection mode by selecting sentence nearest to speech cursor.
descriptions.SELECT_PARAGRAPH: Enter selection mode by selecting paragraph nearest to speech cursor.
descriptions.INCREASE_SELECTION_RATE: Accelerates the rate of selection playback (in addition to the playback rate).
descriptions.DECREASE_SELECTION_RATE: Decelerates the rate of selection playback (in addition to the playback rate).
descriptions.SELECT_COMMIT: Enter selection mode by selecting last commit.
descriptions.PASTE_CLIPBOARD: Insert copied speech and its audio after the selection anchor or at the insertion point.
descriptions.EXPORT_AUDIO: (During export process) Represents audio export format.
descriptions.EXPORT_TEXT: Navigate out of the dictionary back to entry list.
descriptions.WALK_ENTRY_LIST: Repeat a ten-second preview of the selected entry. Use Next or Previous to move through the library.
descriptions.RUN_ENTRY_LIST: Preview each entry for up to ten seconds and advance automatically. Stop at the end of the library.
descriptions.START_ECHO: Read the entry or selected passage using a local system voice.
descriptions.SKIP_PLAYBACK_BACKWARD: Move ten seconds backward in the edited recording.
descriptions.SKIP_PLAYBACK_FORWARD: Move ten seconds forward in the edited recording.
descriptions.ENTER_SELECTION: Select the word at the insertion point. With headphones, its original audio repeats.
descriptions.SHIFT_ANCHOR_RIGHT: Move the beginning of the selection one word right.
descriptions.SHIFT_ANCHOR_LEFT: Move the beginning of the selection one word left.
descriptions.SHIFT_FOCUS_RIGHT: Move the end of the selection one word right.
descriptions.SHIFT_FOCUS_LEFT: Move the end of the selection one word left.
descriptions.SHIFT_SELECTION_FORWARD: Move the selection to the next word, sentence or paragraph, retaining its scale.
descriptions.SHIFT_SELECTION_BACKWARD: Move the selection to the previous word, sentence or paragraph, retaining its scale.
descriptions.SHIFT_NEXT_WALK_ELEMENT: Move to the next word or entry in the current walk.
descriptions.SHIFT_PREVIOUS_WALK_ELEMENT: Move to the previous word or entry in the current walk.
descriptions.ACCEPT_SELECTION_UPDATE: Replace the selection with the spoken draft and its original recording.
descriptions.REDO_SELECTION_UPDATE: Discard the replacement draft and speak another attempt. Keep the original selection.
descriptions.CANCEL_SELECTION_UPDATE: Discard the replacement draft and keep the original selection and recording.
descriptions.ROLLBACK_COMMIT: Remove the most recently committed speech while retaining earlier commits. Undo can restore it.
descriptions.INSPECT_CLIPBOARD: Play the original recording of the passage copied to the Lingual clipboard.
descriptions.ENTER_DICTIONARY: Open descriptions and examples of the available voice actions.
descriptions.UNDO_CHANGE: Restore the previous text, audio links, selection and speed changes.
descriptions.REDO_CHANGE: Reapply the last undone text and audio edit.
descriptions.GRANT_PERMISSION: Prepare local speech recognition and request browser microphone permission when listening starts.
descriptions.CANCEL_DIALOG: Dismiss the current dialog without performing its action.
descriptions.CONTINUE_DIALOG: Accept the action offered by the current dialog.
descriptions.ACTIVATE_PUNCTUATION: Enable reading punctuation names aloud during echo.
descriptions.DEACTIVATE_PUNCTUATION: Disable reading punctuation names aloud during echo.
descriptions.ACTIVATE_SILENCES: Enable retaining recorded pauses during playback and audio export.
descriptions.DEACTIVATE_SILENCES: Disable retaining recorded pauses during playback and audio export.
descriptions.ACTIVATE_TEMPORAL_SUGGESTIONS: Enable showing long pauses as additional spacing.
descriptions.DEACTIVATE_TEMPORAL_SUGGESTIONS: Disable showing long pauses as additional spacing.
descriptions.ACTIVATE_PUNCTUATION_SUGGESTIONS: Enable showing Whisper punctuation and native pause suggestions.
descriptions.DEACTIVATE_PUNCTUATION_SUGGESTIONS: Disable showing Whisper punctuation and native pause suggestions.
descriptions.ACTIVATE_FORMATTING_SUGGESTIONS: Enable emphasizing words spoken more loudly.
descriptions.DEACTIVATE_FORMATTING_SUGGESTIONS: Disable emphasizing words spoken more loudly.
descriptions.ACTIVATE_PASSIVE_ECHO: Enable reading newly committed speech back when headphones are enabled.
descriptions.DEACTIVATE_PASSIVE_ECHO: Disable reading newly committed speech back when headphones are enabled.
